THE FINAL CHAPTER · FOR MOKSHADA

Happy birthday,
Boku.

Somehow, a German class in Nashik gave me someone in the UK while I ended up in Italy. The distance was never part of the plan, but getting this close to you is the best unexpected thing that happened.

I still remember those walks after class: twenty-five minutes together, then you turned left and I went right. It looked like a small, ordinary part of the day then. Now it feels like the beginning of a story I never want to lose.

Through calls, ordinary conversations and all these kilometres, you quietly became one of the most important parts of my life. That is strange, slightly unbelievable, and completely true.

My love for you is pure, and I do not take what we have lightly. For me, loyalty and honesty are everything in a relationship. I promise to give you both with my whole heart, and I need the same from you. So here is my one gentle warning, Boku: protect my heart the way I will protect yours. If life ever feels confusing, choose honesty over silence and never let distance or misunderstandings come between us. I want something real, peaceful and lasting with you.

Thank you for every call, every laugh and every ordinary moment that became important because it was with you.

Happy Birthday, Bokya. This chapter is already my favourite one.

With love, from the person who cannot wait to see you ♡
MISSION COMPLETE

Boku, your real gift is waiting.

You followed our story, accepted our first date and reached the final page.

Now make one birthday wish, close your eyes for three seconds, and open the gift waiting for you.

The gift may be small, but the meaning behind it is not. I chose it for you, with love.
